### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in both files are interconnected as they collectively remove the `layer_split` property from the `komeda` driver. The removal of the property declaration in `komeda_kms.h` directly corresponds to the elimination of related getter and setter functions in `komeda_plane.c`, which were designed to manage the state of this property. Additionally, the removal of the property creation function indicates a complete discontinuation of the `layer_split` feature within the driver, ensuring that no remnants of this property remain in the codebase. This change reflects a broader effort to standardize driver properties and reduce unnecessary complexity in the kernel driver.
